trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side strands, then the long collectible and activity grinds — and this is the last trophy you will hear. Keep one manual save from before the final mission, just in case a late trophy needs a replay of a chapter.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing, the first story mission of the game, and finish it. It is unmissable: it pops as part of the story, so just follow the mission markers and complete each objective. This is the first story trophy most players will earn.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter ends. Before the chapter closes, do the one thing in it that cannot be repeated: Lucia's balcony meditation, which counts toward Positive Mental Attitude. Make a manual save at the start of the chapter so you can go back if you miss it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Character switching between Jason and Lucia should open during this chapter, which unlocks the partner trophies and the Scooter Bros app. Nothing in this chapter's trophy can be missed — just finish the story missions in order.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This is the chapter where several robbery tools arrive, including the Snap Gun from the jewelry jobs, so use the chapter to start Sneakthief and the other robbery trophies. Also watch for the time-sensitive street race in Yago's strand — it counts toward Strangers & Freaks, so save before you race it.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of this chapter an optional mission opens the bank vault robberies, which you need for Maximum Withdrawal, so take that mission when it appears rather than rushing the chapter's final story mission. The chapter trophy itself cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. Before you start it, make a manual save in a slot you do not overwrite: after the credits, free roam stays open, but a save from before the finale is your safety net for anything tied to the story's ending. The trophy pops when the mission — and the story — is done.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named story missions like this one are unmissable: they appear in the mission flow, and the trophy pops when the mission's final objective is done. If the mission does not appear yet, keep playing the story — it unlocks in sequence.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Like the other named-mission trophies, it is unmissable and pops when the heist is finished. Heist missions tend to be long with several stages, so stock up on ammo and armour before starting, and use a manual save beforehand.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks in the story's natural order and cannot be missed — finish the mission and the trophy follows. If you are stuck on a mission, the in-game objective marker and the mission's own checkpoints are the guide; retry from the last checkpoint rather than restarting the whole mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a named story mission, so it is unmissable: play the story in order and the trophy pops on completion. There is no mission replay in this game, so treat each story mission as a one-shot and keep chapter-start saves as a safety net.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable story trophy: finish the mission and it pops. The airport is also where Catch Me If You Can happens, so while you are in the area, remember that the airliner trophy needs a plane docked at a boarding bridge — but that one can wait until free roam.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is one of the named late-story missions and is unmissable — it pops when the mission ends. Late missions can be combat-heavy, so go in with full armour and a stocked weapon wheel, and save before starting.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist itself only appears after the story, under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — but work done earlier still counts, so start the grind early. It covers the big counts: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. Treat every other trophy as a step toward this one; it is the last gold most players earn, just before the platinum.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and the counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so every stunt you do while travelling counts. Keep going after the trophy: 100% completion needs 300 stunts. Fast vehicles and the stunt plane help, and the in-game stats track your running total.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The PSN counter runs to 9, so work through the activity list methodically: races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and the rest. Anything you already did while playing counts, so check the counter in the trophy's progress on PSN to see which types are left, then try one of each remaining type.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across the two shooting ranges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each challenge's target pattern, use the right weapon for the range, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold is met — the medal is per challenge, so you can perfect them one at a time. It is often listed among the hardest trophies, so leave it for a focused session rather than squeezing it between missions.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. You need at least one win at each location, not at every race, so visit each location once and win there. Drone races are about smooth lines rather than top speed: learn each course's turns on a practice run, then race it for the win. The locations stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: winning the same race twice counts once, so work through the race list and tick off a new event each time. Street races, and the race in Yago's strand, all count toward the total, and the races stay open after the story, so there is no rush — but do Yago's race the moment it appears, because that strand is time-sensitive.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges appear as part of the fishing activity: take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him. The fishing itself is the skill — watch the line tension, reel steadily, and do not let the fish snap the line. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy only needs one win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet — arcades and bars around Vice City have them — pick any game and play it through to its end. It does not need a high score or a win, just a full playthrough of one game. This is one of the quickest trophies on the list and a good early tick.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Andy's stranger strand. Stranger strands are optional questlines given by characters around Leonida: take Andy's missions whenever they appear and follow the strand to its final mission. Side-story finales stay available after the main story ends, so this cannot be missed by finishing the story — but do the strand as it appears, since some strands have time-sensitive steps.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Kenton's stranger strand. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear across Leonida and finish the strand. Like the other stranger finales, it stays open after the story, so there is no deadline — but keep the strand moving whenever a new mission shows up, rather than leaving them all for the endgame.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Billy's stranger strand. Billy's missions are part of the optional stranger questlines: take each one as it appears and follow the strand to its end. The finale stays available after the credits, so it cannot be missed by finishing the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Not every optional questline counts: Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's strands have their own trophies and do not count here, so you need eight other strands. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish to see which ones counted. Warning: the race against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive — it carries an hourglass marker, so save first and race it the moment it appears, or that strand may be lost.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Randy's stranger strand. Follow Randy's missions as they appear and finish the strand. The finale stays available after the story, so there is no risk of missing it by completing the campaign — just keep taking Randy's missions when they show up on the map.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission in Tyrone's stranger strand. Tyrone's missions are optional side content: take them as they appear and play the strand through to its final mission. It stays open after the story, so it cannot be missed by finishing the campaign.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close. Bring your partner along: each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters, which saves repeat visits. MISSABLE: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation — after Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter until this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine, which is what a hunting quest rewards. Follow Bret's strand as it appears; the hunt targets are unique animals, so track them through the questline rather than hunting at random.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete when you hold every card in it. Collect as you travel — pick up every card you pass rather than leaving them for a cleanup run — and keep a note of which sets are one card short so you can hunt the missing card deliberately. The sets stay available after the story.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK is the in-game social app: open it at landmarks and notable spots around Leonida and post from there. Fold this into normal play — WAiNK at every new place you visit — and it fills up on its own. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts as discovering them for Whip It Good, so the two trophies progress together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play — driving, shooting, flying and exploring all feed them. Open the list early, see which ones are close to done, and finish the easy ones deliberately. Keep going after the trophy: 100% completion needs 70 of the 80 Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star Wanted Level and then lose it by escaping the heat — the search area must fully clear, not just fade. The easiest reliable setup is a bank vault robbery, which gives you 4 stars straight away: rob the vault with your partner, then drive out of the red heat zone until the stars clear. The trophy pops once you have left the zone, so keep driving until it triggers.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without losing your Wanted Level — the chain must stay hot the whole time. Call your partner first, then hit three shops close together while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before hitting a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive — variety matters, not ownership, so scan every new model you see. It pairs naturally with You WAiNKer! Keep going after the trophy: 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of enemies close together, such as the guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle so you can drop several before the Focus ends. Adrenaline extends Focus, so use it if you have it. If you only get four, reload the save and try a denser group.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport: steal a large passenger plane that is docked at a boarding bridge. Planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. The planes at gates E3 and E4 work: get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The trophy is delayed — fly about 1 km away from the airport and it pops. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank — a Rhino. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until the trophy pops. Expect a heavy police response, so go in with a plan for getting out afterwards.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Bank vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. Each vault job gives you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. The 100% checklist needs all eight vaults, so keep going past five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads: hit one, take its cargo and get clear of the police. The trophy pops once you have escaped, not when you crack the truck — so the getaway matters as much as the robbery. Pick a quiet stretch of road, strike fast, and drive out of the heat zone before the response builds.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the PSN counter runs to 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map: the city, the beaches, the swamps, the islands and the far southwest. The counter ticks as you uncover new areas, so a systematic sweep works best: clear one region at a time instead of wandering. It pairs well with Whip It Good, since you will scan new vehicles as you explore.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Illegal operations are marked around the map — each belongs to a gang, so you need one from every gang, not nine from one. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this trophy pops on the way to that bigger goal. Note what each operation belongs to as you rob it, so you can see which gangs are still missing.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water and order a cocktail there. No confirmed method has been published yet at launch beyond the description itself — the trigger is a specific spot and a drink, so try the beachfront bars and order at the bar while facing the ocean. Sources: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; no guide has confirmed the exact spot yet, so this guide claims nothing more.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front and out the other side. Pick a showroom with a clear exit line, build speed outside, and drive through. No confirmed method has been published yet at launch beyond the description itself, so this guide claims nothing more than the description: a showroom, a vehicle, and a dramatic exit. Save first in case the attempt goes wrong.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable — you can return and finish the job.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — train with your partner. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength: buy a gym membership and train at a gym with your partner along, since the partner trains alongside you. Work on Strength with both characters over time rather than in one session — it is a long build, so fold gym visits into your routine between missions.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Reach 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The PSN counter runs to 500, and robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind — just play the game the way the list asks: rob, fight, and make the choices the game offers. Check the counter now and then; if it is lagging late in the game, pick up more robberies and illegal operations.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — a hidden event with no confirmed trigger published yet at launch. The description suggests failing at something once and succeeding on the second try, but no guide has confirmed which event it is. Do not chase this one deliberately: play normally, retry things that fail, and it should surface. Sources: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide claims nothing beyond it until a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — a hidden encounter with no confirmed trigger published yet at launch. The description points to a strange, unexplained event somewhere in Leonida, likely a random or one-off encounter. Explore odd corners of the map and take the strange side content as you find it. Sources: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide claims nothing beyond it until a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by: strike targets with a melee weapon while driving past. No confirmed method has been published yet at launch beyond the description itself — the words suggest a drive-by using a melee weapon rather than a gun, at speed, against a group. Try it against a cluster of enemies from a slow-moving vehicle, and save first. Sources: the official description on Exophase and PSNProfiles; this guide claims nothing beyond it until a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them, and the $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole playthrough. Bank vaults and payday jobs are the supply, so keep doing them — the laundering total climbs alongside Maximum Withdrawal. There is no single big payout to chase; it is a steady total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop — clothes, weapons, food, vehicles, everything — so it fills up naturally as you gear up for the rest of the list. If you are close near the end, the fastest top-up is expensive: a big weapon or vehicle purchase closes the gap in one buy. Do not waste money early just for this; let it come.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy them in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count — only the eight you buy. Buy garages before you start On the Spot, because each registered car needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the Scooter Bros app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes) and register cheap cars you do not mind keeping.

meta.title: GTA VI — Leonida Trophy Guide
meta.note: Names, descriptions, grades and PSN progress targets are the official list as published by PlayStation and mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (checked 19 Nov 2026). Guides are original writing for this entry; where a specific step comes from a published guide, that guide is named in the trophy's sources. Five trophies had no confirmed method at launch, and their guides say so plainly instead of inventing one.
